fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (17-foot Alumacraft square-stern canoe with outriggers), which is a small watercraft we can clean and polish.
findings: Dull, flat factory paint finish along the exterior hull sides
Dirt, dust and grass debris on the floor of the canoe interior
White chalky residue and grime on the interior floor near the stern seat
Scuffs and paint wear on the gunwales and stern corner
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Alumacraft CO17 canoe. The interior floor has some dirt and white residue near the stern, and the green paint along the hull looks a bit flat in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups and can come to you to wash, clean up the inside and touch up the scuffs on the gunwales. Would you like a quote?
